findings.reason: the override's loss would surface as an absent record in those tests only if they also had a record at the owner path, and adding that arm is a test detail a worker can add without changing the plan's contract.
findings.text: §4 keeps the `RECKON_FLEET_RECORD` override but its done-when tests only the `FLEET_NAME` delegation, so nothing asserts the override still wins over it (the two existing tests that set the override, `tests/test_dispatch_spawns_through_the_fleet.py:229` and `:320`, would still pass if the override were dropped and the owner path read instead, because both write the record at the override path only)
